title: Lapse Notice Days by Certificate Type: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
Under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), a lapse SR-26 is the SR-26 sent for a certificate whose backing term was cancelled and has since been reinstated with a lapse. On a lapse SR-26, lapse type notice days are added to the lapse run-off. They follow the certificate type, which fixes the kind of backing term the certificate rests on:

1. An Owner-Operator certificate on an Owner Auto Policy backing term adds 2 days.
2. An Operator certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy backing term adds 1 day.
3. An Owner certificate adds no lapse type notice days.

**Cases (hypothetical)**

- **Owner-Operator, owner term.** An SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate resting on an Owner Auto Policy term: 2 days.
- **Operator, non-owner term.** An FR-44 Operator Certificate resting on a Named Non-Owner Policy term: 1 day.
- **Owner certificate.** An FR-44 Owner Certificate resting on an Owner Auto Policy term: no days under this rule.
- **Form does not matter.** An SR-22 and an FR-44 certificate of the same type receive the same number of days under this rule.
